structured_output.summary: Added GET /links, routed before the /:slug redirect. It returns {items, nextCursor} in creation order, with a default limit of 20 and a cap of 100. A non-positive-integer limit returns 400 "invalid limit", and a malformed cursor returns 400 "invalid cursor". The cursor is an opaque base64url of a per-link sequence number that the store assigns and never reuses, so deleting a link between pages doesn't break paging. The last page, including an exact multiple of the limit, gets nextCursor null. New test/list-links.test.js covers the empty store, item shape and order, the 20/20/5 walk over 45 links, the exact-multiple end, clamping at 100, invalid limits, invalid cursors, deletion between pages, and that redirect and stats still work. npm test passes (14 tests).
